001: I found a part-time job at the café near campus.
Oh really? That's good news, right?
Yes, I'm happy, but I'm going to work on the weekends.
You're going to be tired, then. What exactly are you going to do?
I'm going to serve at the counter and handle the orders.
Okay, I hope you'll like it.
002: Did you see the ad for the library job?
Yes, I saw it, but I think it's too late.
Why? They're still accepting applications until Friday.
Oh, I didn't know that. Do you think I have a chance?
Of course, you're very organized, it's perfect for that position.
Thanks, I'm going to send in my application tonight.
003: How's your job at the restaurant going?
It's pretty intense, especially in the evening.
Are you managing to handle it with your classes?
It's hard, but I organize myself well.
You're right, you have to find a good balance.
Yes, and the money is worth it, I have to admit.
004: I'm looking for a job for the summer, do you have any ideas?
You could do babysitting, I have a friend who's looking.
Oh, that's a good lead. Do you know which days?
I think it's mostly Wednesdays and weekends.
Good luck, I hope it works out.
005: My boss asked me to work extra hours.
Yes, I said yes, but I'm a little tired.
You should be careful not to work too much.
I know, but I need the money to pay for my studies.
I understand, but think about yourself too.
006: Did you sign your work contract?
Not yet, I have to bring in a few documents.
Just an ID and a bank account statement.
Oh, that's simple then. When are you going to do it?
Tomorrow morning, before going to class.
007: I'm going to give private math lessons.
That's a good idea, you're really good at that.
Thanks, I hope it goes well.
Yes, two high school students to start with.
Great, you're going to make some money easily.
008: Did you know the bookstore downtown is looking for someone?
Oh no, I didn't know that. What type of position is it for?
It's to help stock the shelves and work the register.
That interests me, I'm going to drop off my resume.
Good idea, they're really nice over there.
Thanks for the info, I'll tell you how it goes.
009: I had an interview for a job at a hotel.
Oh, that's great. How did it go?
Pretty well, I think. They're looking for someone serious.
Did you talk about your availability?
Yes, I said I could work evenings.
Perfect, I hope you get the position.
010: I'm exhausted, I worked all day.
I helped tidy up the store and do the inventory.
Yeah, but at least I finished earlier than expected.
Good, you'll be able to rest a bit.
